map.name: Thrumm
map.setting: a cave town of miners under a mountain
map.trouble: Vorga the Stone Witch has woken the Golems of the Deep Halls, and the mines of Thrumm have gone silent.

guard_bark.specifics: Tullis at the town gate of Thrumm; the Golems of the Deep Halls are the trouble.

first.speaker: Tullis
first.text: Welcome to Thrumm, stranger! Mind your head. Warlord Gorran is waiting for you in the Great Hall, straight ahead.

again.speaker: Tullis
again.text: You call that armor? You won't last a day in the Deep Halls.

later.speaker: Tullis
later.text: Hail, brave Adventurer! All of Thrumm honors your valor!

bounty_offer.specifics: Foreman Kessick posts the Miners' Guild bounty on the Giant Leeches of the Sump and hands over the Sump gate key.

offer.speaker: Foreman Kessick
offer.text:
Attention! By order of the Miners' Guild, a bounty has been posted on the Giant Leeches of the Sump! These loathsome creatures have bled my finest diggers nearly dry. As if the Golems of Vorga were not horror enough!

The Sump is east of the lift. Here is the key to its gate. Will you go down there and destroy them?

reminder.speaker: Foreman Kessick
reminder.text: Are the Leeches dead yet? My men refuse to go below until they are.

completion.speaker: Foreman Kessick
completion.text: The Leeches are dead? Excellent work! The Miners' Guild always pays its debts. Here is your bounty, 100 gold pieces.

journal.text: Destroy the Giant Leeches in the Sump for Foreman Kessick.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Hargo the assayer, a grumbling old man; the Imps of the Chimney stole his Crystal Lens.

offer.speaker: Hargo
offer.text:
Oh, what now? Can't a man grieve in peace?

Very well, since you insist. Those miserable Imps from the Chimney have stolen my Crystal Lens! My life's work is finished! These are the darkest of times, with the Stone Witch beneath our feet, and now this!

If you were to bring back my Lens, I would be forever in your debt. Take this potion. Those Imps bite. Well? Will you help a ruined old man?

refusal.speaker: Hargo
refusal.text: Then go! Leave an old man to his misery!

reminder.speaker: Hargo
reminder.text: Those wretched Imps get bolder every day.

completion.speaker: Hargo
completion.text: My Lens! You found it?! Oh, happy day! Please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Recover Hargo's Crystal Lens from the Imps of the Chimney.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Hargo's Crystal Lens from the Imps of the Chimney.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Thrumm: Varn teases, Nella points to the inn, Fobb worries about the Golems.

rumour1.speaker: Varn
rumour1.text: Well, look at you, all shiny and clean. Come see me when you've got some dirt on your face, hero.

rumour2.speaker: Nella
rumour2.text: If you want a hot meal and a bed, the Deep Mug is just past the Great Hall

rumour3.speaker: Fobb
rumour3.text: Oh.... The Golems come up the shafts every night now. What will become of us?

shop_greeting.specifics: Bulgo of the Deep Mug inn (and coffins), Dask the armorer, Yselde of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bulgo
inn.text: Welcome to the Deep Mug, friend! Beds upstairs, coffins out back. Either way ya get a good long rest! Heh, heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Dask
arms.text: Welcome to Dask's Armory! The finest steel under the mountain. How can I help you?

magic.speaker: Yselde
magic.text: Don't touch the scrolls with those filthy hands. Buy something or get out.

two_givers.specifics: Guildmistress Ottilie wants the ore lift's crank back from the Deep Halls; Varn wants her signature on his claim to the Old Shaft.

offer_a.speaker: Guildmistress Ottilie
offer_a.text: Greetings, brave Adventurer! Oh, thank goodness you've come, because ever since Vorga's Golems came up out of the Deep Halls the great ore lift has stood still and the crank was carried off below, and nobody in this whole town will go down after it, not the miners, not the guards, not even Warlord Gorran's own men, and without the lift there is no ore and without ore Thrumm is finished, finished I tell you! So here is my bargain. Take this key to the lower lift gate, bring me back the crank, and I will teach you the Light spell. Do we have a deal?

offer_b.speaker: Varn
offer_b.text: You there. The Guildmistress likes you, doesn't she? She won't sign my claim to the Old Shaft. Put in a good word, get her name on this paper, and these boots are yours. What do you say?

outcome_a.speaker: Guildmistress Ottilie
outcome_a.text: My crank! The lift will run again! Thank you, thank you! Here is the Light spell, as I promised.

outcome_b.speaker: Varn
outcome_b.text: She signed it! The Old Shaft is mine at last! Here, take the boots.

journal_a.text: Bring the lift crank back to Guildmistress Ottilie.

journal_b.text: Get Guildmistress Ottilie to sign Varn's claim to the Old Shaft.

rescue.specifics: Foreman Kessick begs the player to bring back Master Quill, held by the Golems in the Deep Halls; Quill gives the key to his apprentices' cell.

plea.speaker: Foreman Kessick
plea.text: Stranger! Master Quill is trapped down in the Deep Halls with the Golems! Bring him back alive and the best scroll in the Guild is yours! Go! Hurry!

found.speaker: Master Quill
found.text: You came for me? Ha! Good. Here, take this key. My apprentices are locked up further down. Get them out too, lad.

following.speaker: Master Quill
following.text: Lead the way. I'm right behind you.

completion.speaker: Foreman Kessick
completion.text:
Master Quill! You brought him back alive! The Guild thanks you. This scroll is yours.

Now go and see Warlord Gorran. He must hear what Master Quill saw down there.

journal.text: Rescue Master Quill from the Golems in the Deep Halls.

main_opening.specifics: Fobb sends the player to Warlord Gorran in the Great Hall; Gorran, sent word by Ulgrim, orders the player down to destroy Vorga the Stone Witch and gives gold and potions.

herald.speaker: Fobb
herald.text: Warlord Gorran has been shouting for you all morning! He's in the Great Hall. I'd hurry if I was you.

opening.speaker: Warlord Gorran
opening.text:
So! Ulgrim finally sent me somebody. About time! Stand up straight, lad, and listen well.

Vorga the Stone Witch has woken the Golems of the Deep Halls. Every night they march up the shafts and crush anything in their path! The mines of Thrumm have gone silent. This cannot stand!

You must go down into the Deep Halls and destroy Vorga. Take this gold and these potions. Dask can sell you a decent sword. Now go, and do not come back until the Witch is dead!

reminder.speaker: Warlord Gorran
reminder.text: What are you waiting for, lad? Vorga grows stronger every night!

journal.text: Go down into the Deep Halls and destroy Vorga the Stone Witch.
